critiques.claim: Stakeholder conflicts can be resolved through negotiation or configurable software options.
critiques.critique: Treats conflict as a negotiation problem between equal actors. It understates structural power imbalances, representation gaps, data subjects, affected non-users, and cases where consensus would itself be unethical.
critiques.nuance: Stakeholder mapping remains essential, but must expand to include non-user affected parties and ethical harm modeling.
sources: Selbst et al. (2019) Fairness and Abstraction in Sociotechnical Systems

extensions.title: Topic 9.5 Sociotechnical & Affected-Party Analysis
extensions.summary: Mapping power dynamics, non-user data subjects, ethical value elicitation (IEEE 7000), and harm modeling.
